headline: Khon Kaen Hub processing has slowed sharply and is now the main driver of SLA misses on 3 lanes; separately, BKK-CNX and the Hat Yai lanes are losing first attempts.

issues.title: Khon Kaen Hub processing slowdown
issues.one_liner: Khon Kaen hub parcels wait 25.8h instead of 5.8h, so 3 lanes deliver late
issues.what_happened: Median inbound processing at KKC was 25.8h vs a usual 5.8h for this weekday, and outbound was 23.1h vs 6.7h. On-time delivery fell to 72.5% on BKK-KKC and 65.6% on CBI-KKC.
issues.likely_cause: Time is being lost inside the hub, not on the road: linehaul is unchanged (6.1h vs 6.0h on BKK-KKC) and first-attempt success on these lanes is normal. The inbound median has risen every day for 10 days, which points to a capacity or backlog problem that is building.
evidence: KKC inbound median 25.8h vs 5.8h same-weekday baseline; P90 37.9h vs 8.8h
CBI-KKC on-time 65.6% vs 92.1% (dropped 26.5pp); KKC-BKK on-time 82.7% vs 95.0%
Linehaul BKK-KKC 6.1h vs 6.0h baseline: no road delay
issues.suggested_action: Call the KKC hub lead today: check sorter uptime, shift staffing and backlog size since the slowdown started, and divert or add a night shift until the inbound median is back under target.
issues.control_metric: KKC inbound median processing time back under 10h for 3 consecutive days

issues.title: BKK-CNX first attempts failing on address issues, hidden by re-attempts
issues.one_liner: BKK-CNX first deliveries fail more (72.9% vs 85.2% success), mostly wrong addresses
issues.what_happened: First-attempt success fell to 72.9% vs 85.2% baseline (dropped 12.3pp), and attempts per parcel rose to 1.29 from 1.15. Final delivered rate is still 100.0%, so a delivered-rate dashboard would show nothing wrong.
issues.likely_cause: address_issue now makes up 71.4% of first-attempt failures vs 45.6% normally, across both morning and afternoon slots. Hub and linehaul times are normal, so the problem is likely in address data or courier routing for this lane, not in the network.
evidence: address_issue 71.4% of failures vs 45.6% baseline (30 parcels yesterday)
Morning fail rate 27.6% vs 14.8%; afternoon 30.9% vs 14.7%
Attempts per parcel 1.29 vs 1.15, on-time 84.3% vs 89.8%
issues.suggested_action: Pull yesterday's 30 address_issue parcels and check whether they share a sender, district or recent address-format change; review with the CNX last-mile team.
issues.control_metric: BKK-CNX first-attempt success at or above 85.0%, and address_issue share back under 45.6%

issues.title: Hat Yai afternoon delivery failures
issues.one_liner: Hat Yai afternoon deliveries fail more (38.0% vs 13.5%): customers not home
issues.what_happened: First-attempt success fell to 76.6% on BKK-HDY (dropped 12.7pp) and 75.0% on CBI-HDY (dropped 13.6pp). On-time delivery is unaffected because re-attempts succeed.
issues.likely_cause: Failures are concentrated in the afternoon 12-17 slot (38.0% fail vs 13.5% normally on BKK-HDY) and almost all are customer_not_available, so customers are likely not home at the time couriers arrive in Hat Yai.
evidence: BKK-HDY afternoon fail rate 38.0% vs 13.5%; morning 8.8% vs 7.0%
customer_not_available is 89.2% of BKK-HDY failures vs 63.5% baseline
issues.suggested_action: Ask the HDY team whether afternoon routes changed recently; test moving part of the afternoon wave to the evening slot or sending a pre-delivery SMS.
issues.control_metric: BKK-HDY afternoon first-attempt fail rate back under 13.5% for 5 days

watchlist: BKK outbound processing is slower on weekends (median 10.2h vs 5.4h on weekdays); this is recurring, not new.
summary_th: ฮับขอนแก่นใช้เวลาประมวลผลพัสดุขาเข้าเฉลี่ย 25.8 ชม. (ปกติ 5.8 ชม.) ทำให้ส่งตรงเวลาของเส้นทาง BKK-KKC ลดเหลือ 72.5% และ CBI-KKC เหลือ 65.6% ส่วนเส้นทาง BKK-CNX ส่งสำเร็จครั้งแรกลดเหลือ 72.9% จากปัญหาที่อยู่ และเส้นทางหาดใหญ่ส่งไม่สำเร็จช่วงบ่ายสูงขึ้นเพราะลูกค้าไม่อยู่
